objects.description: For iOS, detect Evade Analysis Environment primarily during application vetting or controlled analysis rather than assuming a live device SOC feed. Alert on a sequence or state change inconsistent with the device/app baseline, approved management policy, or expected user workflow; do not infer unobserved API calls, file/process activity, or payload content from management state alone.
